source_title: Munich Re expects India to occupy more space in global portfolio: Jurecka - Business Standard
source_excerpt: Munich Re, one of the world’s largest reinsurers, expects India’s share of its overall portfolio to rise over the coming decades, driven by low insurance penetration, strong economic growth, and rising demand for risk protection. Christoph Jurecka, Chair of the board of management and group chief executive officer of Munich Re, tells Aathira Varier in Mumbai that the company is prepared to deploy more capital in India as attractive opportunities emerge. He also discusses the softening reinsurance market, the scope for growth in natural catastrophe coverage, and why Munich Re remains committed to its nearly two-decade-long partnership with HDFC Bank in HDFC Ergo General Insurance.
